## Fixes

- Fixes Windows installs that kept showing the IIS default page after upgrade by moving the WebView2 profile used by the main window to a clean app-owned directory.
- Forces the Windows release job to rebuild the Tauri executable after restoring Rust cache, so downloaded Perfetto UI dist assets cannot be shadowed by a stale cached binary.

## Verification

- Locally rebuilt the Windows NSIS package with the Linux-built Perfetto UI dist.
- Launched the release executable with the existing default WebView2 profile and confirmed the main WebView reports `Perfetto UI` and loads `v55.0-086179353/frontend_bundle.js` instead of the cached IIS page.
